summary: AI Co-Pilot for Chemical Process Optimization

founders.name: Alexander Pomberger
founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.bio: Alexander holds a PhD in chemical engineering, and has been working at the intersection of machine learning, chemistry and lab automation for the past 5 years. In his research, Alexander developed optimization algorithms to aid in designing manufacturing processes for novel pharmaceuticals. Alexander launched ReactWise to democratize access to AI in pharma & biotech with no-code software.
